label: Quality screen
line: Quality screen - 50% - top 25, re-pick every 3 months; US companies above $10B; must pass: average ROIC 12%+, no year of negative ROIC, revenue up in 60%+ of years, positive free cash flow. Ranked by score: quality 35%, growth 25%, value 20%, financial strength 10%, momentum 10%.
plain: Owns the 25 highest-scoring large, profitable, growing US companies, equal weight, and refreshes the list every quarter. Buy and hold between refreshes; no stop-loss (none was backtested).
screen: US companies above $10B; must pass: average ROIC 12%+, no year of negative ROIC, revenue up in 60%+ of years, positive free cash flow. Ranked by score: quality 35%, growth 25%, value 20%, financial strength 10%, momentum 10%.
metrics: Return vs the equal-weight S&P 500 (RSP) first, then SPY. Backtest: 17.9%/yr, Sharpe 0.89 vs same-universe 11.4%.
watch: Each quarter's 25 picks vs RSP; whether the average pick is still cheap enough (forward P/E, FCF yield).

label: Bottleneck (money-flow rotation)
line: Bottleneck (money-flow rotation) - 20% - top 8, re-pick every 14 days, exit below the 100-day average; Industries ranked by money flow (relative strength vs SPY); stocks above $10B (theme-map companies from $2B) must pass: revenue +10% year on year, gross margin not falling, price above its 100-day average. Score: bottleneck 35%, flow 25%, asymmetry 25%, insider buying 15%. Weighted by inverse volatility.
plain: Being replaced by plain momentum at its 2026-11-03 re-pick (amendment 00e1f2b8, accepted 2026-10-20). Finds where money is flowing and holds the 8 best stocks there, especially the scarce suppliers (e.g. power for AI data centres). Refreshes every 2 weeks and sells any stock that closes below its 100-day average.
screen: Industries ranked by money flow (relative strength vs SPY); stocks above $10B (theme-map companies from $2B) must pass: revenue +10% year on year, gross margin not falling, price above its 100-day average. Score: bottleneck 35%, flow 25%, asymmetry 25%, insider buying 15%. Weighted by inverse volatility.
metrics: Return vs SPY after costs. Backtest (price flows only): 17.0%/yr, Sharpe 0.60, worst drop -46%. An isolated best setting - expect less.
watch: Do stocks keep falling after the 100-day exit? Does it beat SPY after its higher trading costs?

label: Overnight
line: Overnight - 30% - Top 20 by average overnight return (close to next open) over 12 months; price over $10, $20M a day traded; equal weight; re-picked monthly.
plain: Holds the 20 large US stocks that have earned the most overnight over the past year - bought in the closing auction (3:32pm New York), sold at the next open by the evening run, every trading day. Replaced SPY momentum (amendment 330e76e0, accepted 2026-10-21).
screen: Top 20 by average overnight return (close to next open) over 12 months; price over $10, $20M a day traded; equal weight; re-picked monthly.
metrics: Fill cost vs the official close/open (break-even about 0.045% per trade; the desk-level case needs about 0.02%). Backtest 2014-2026 at 0.02%: 16.7%/yr, Sharpe 0.81, worst drop -28%.
watch: Costs first: `overnight review`. No crash switch - it stays invested in falling markets (March 2020: -20%).
